name: Payment Status
definition: Specifies the status of a payment at a specified time.

Status.name: Status
Status.definition: Specifies the status of the payment execution.

PendingSettlement.name: Pending Settlement
PendingSettlement.definition: Reason the instruction is pending settlement, ie, delivery or receipt of the financial instrument. Settlement on the instructed settlement date is still possible.

InstructionStatus.name: Instruction Status
InstructionStatus.definition: Specifies the state of a payment instruction.

TransactionRejectionReason.name: Transaction Rejection Reason
TransactionRejectionReason.definition: Specifies the reason to reject, return or reverse the transaction.

NotificationStatus.name: Notification Status
NotificationStatus.definition: Specifies the status of the payment in comparison with the notification to receive.

TransactionStatus.name: Transaction Status
TransactionStatus.definition: Specifies the processing status of an investment fund transaction.

CashPaymentStatus.name: Cash Payment Status
CashPaymentStatus.definition: Specifies a generic status of a payment at a specified time.

UnsuccessfulStatusReason.name: Unsuccessful Status Reason
UnsuccessfulStatusReason.definition: Reason provided for the status of a transaction.The reason may be in coded or free text form.

CancellationReason.name: Cancellation Reason
CancellationReason.definition: Reason for the cancellation of the payment.

MandateRejectionReason.name: Mandate Rejection Reason
MandateRejectionReason.definition: Reason for requesting the cancellation or the amendment of a mandate.

PendingFailingSettlement.name: Pending Failing Settlement
PendingFailingSettlement.definition: Reason the transaction/instruction is pending due to failing settlement.

Payment.name: Payment
Payment.definition: Payment for which a status is provided.

RelatedInvestigationCase.name: Related Investigation Case
RelatedInvestigationCase.definition: Specifies an investigation case in relation with the payment status.
